optionsTitle.description: Page title of the options page

lang.description: BCP 47 language of this locale; sets <html lang> and number formatting

cacheIntro.message: For each game, Coverly Shelf remembers which artwork address worked, so the next visit shows the cover without probing again. It never stores personal data or your browsing history.

usageEmpty.message: Nothing cached yet. Open a game on hShop.
usageEmpty.description: Usage readout when the cache is empty

usageMore.description: Overflow badge after the drawn spines

retentionLegend.description: Legend of the retention radio group

retentionHintSession.message: Forgotten when you close the browser.

retentionHint1d.message: Kept for a day, then looked up again.

retentionHint7d.message: Kept for a week, then looked up again. This is the default.

retentionHint30d.message: Kept for a month. Fewer requests, but new artwork shows up later.

retentionHintForever.message: Kept until you clear the cache here.

retentionSavedSession.message: Saved: artwork is kept until you close the browser.

retentionSaved1d.message: Saved: artwork is kept for 1 day.

retentionSaved7d.message: Saved: artwork is kept for 7 days.

retentionSaved30d.message: Saved: artwork is kept for 30 days.

retentionSavedForever.message: Saved: artwork is kept until you clear the cache.
retentionSavedForever.description: Live announcement after choosing 'Until I clear it'

retentionSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save this choice. Try again.
retentionSaveFailed.description: Error when the retention setting cannot be saved

clearConfirmText.message: Remove what Coverly Shelf remembers? Covers are looked up again on your next visit.

clearFailed.message: The cache could not be cleared. Try again, or reload the extension.

footerCredits.description: Footer credits, followed by the GameTDB and Libretro links
